events.text: Constellation Software announced a binding agreement to acquire 100% of Total Specific Solutions (TSS) B.V., a Netherlands-based group (Everest, Blueriq, KZA, PharmaPartners, PinkRoccade Local Government, PinkRoccade Healthcare, Yonde), for approximately EUR 240 million before representations-and-warranties adjustments, then the company's largest deal. TSS had annual gross revenue of approximately EUR 174 million and about 1,400 employees. Constellation added a one-year US$350 million term loan to fund the deal.

events.text: Constellation's Q4/FY2012 results release (issued March 6, 2013) declared a regular quarterly dividend of USD 1.00 per share, payable April 4, 2013. This confirms the USD 1.00 quarterly level was in place by early 2013 covering FY2012 results; the exact press release and date on which the dividend was first set to USD 1.00 (as opposed to an earlier, lower level) could not be pinned down within the search budget.

events.text: Constellation's FY2015 and FY2016 annual results releases both disclose organic growth on two bases: as reported, and 'after adjusting for the impact of' US dollar appreciation against other transaction currencies. This confirms the FX-adjusted organic growth disclosure was in use by the FY2015 release (issued February 2016) at the latest. Whether it was introduced earlier (e.g. in FY2013 or FY2014 releases) was not confirmed within the search budget.

events.item: President's letter: hurdle rates and acquisition pace
events.text: Third-party analyses of Mark Leonard's shareholder/president's letters (covering years including part of this window) describe hurdle rates as 'magnetic' (pulling down expected IRRs across all pursued opportunities when lowered) and describe a long-run ambition to expand acquisition capacity from about 40 per year toward 100 per year. These are third-party syntheses of the letters, not direct quotes tied to a specific year's letter within FY2012-2016; the exact letter text and year-by-year hurdle-rate or acquisition-count statements were not confirmed within the search budget.

gaps: FY2013 total company revenue (consolidated) was not found; only a public-sector-segment quarterly figure ($237 million for Q4 2013 vs $190 million Q4 2012) surfaced via search.
FY2016 adjusted_ebita, and FY2012/FY2013/FY2016 organic_growth_pct beyond what is listed, were not found within the search budget.
organic_growth_pct/organic_growth_fx_adj_pct for FY2013 and FY2014 were not found.
maintenance_recurring_revenue was not found for any year in FY2012-2016.
cash_from_operations (annual) was not found for any year in FY2012-2016; only isolated quarterly figures surfaced (Q1 2012 ~$12 million, Q1 2013 ~$34 million).

fcfa2s (Free Cash Flow Available to Shareholders): could not determine the first year this named metric appears in a Constellation release. Search results confirm FCFA2S is used in recent releases (2023 onward found directly) but no source located an early/first-use press release; the metric name may postdate this FY2012-2016 window entirely (the company's cash metric in this window appears to be 'adjusted net income', per items above), but this was not conclusively verified.
acquisitions_cash_spent and acquisition_count (annual counts) were not found for any year in FY2012-2016, beyond the single named TSS acquisition recorded as an event.

shares_outstanding, employees (company-wide), roic_pct, roic_plus_organic_pct, and capex were not found for any year in FY2012-2016. One third-party mention of 'about 30 percent' historical ROIC was found but not tied to a specific year or primary source, so it was not recorded as a figure.

dividends_per_share_special: no special dividend declaration was found dated within FY2012-2016. The only special dividend found in searches (approximately USD 20/share) was dated 2019, outside this window. Treat the window as having no confirmed special dividend, subject to further search.
Exact date/release on which the regular quarterly dividend was first set to USD 1.00 per share was not confirmed; only that it was already USD 1.00 by the FY2012 (March 2013) release.

First year of the FX-adjusted organic growth disclosure was not pinned down beyond confirming it was present in the FY2015 (Feb 2016) and FY2016 (2017) releases; it may have started earlier in the window.

President's letter statements on hurdle rates and target acquisition counts were only found via third-party secondary sources (blogs/substacks), not by directly quoting a specific year's original letter text within FY2012-2016.

For FY2016, two internally-consistent but mutually exclusive pairs of organic-growth figures were returned by search summaries against what appears to be the same underlying MD&A/press release: (-1%, +1% FX-adjusted) attributed as 'twelve months ended', and (+1%, +3% FX-adjusted) attributed elsewhere as covering 'both the three and twelve months ended December 31, 2016'. Both are recorded in figures with conflict notes; not resolved.

For FY2016 revenue, a search also returned $696.8 million (2016) vs $569.8 million (2015) framed as annual figures; based on internal consistency checks against the confirmed annual figures ($2,125.1M / $1,838.3M), these smaller numbers are almost certainly Q4-quarter-only figures mislabeled as annual by the search tool's summarization, not a genuine independent annual source. Not recorded as a revenue figure, flagged here instead.
No WebSearch errors were encountered during this session; all 30 searches in budget returned results (of varying relevance), so none were retried under the 'error, retry once' rule.
